label: Rust on front wings and wheel arches
symptom: Rust develops on the front wings and wheel arches, likely due to vibration from the engine.
cause: Corrosion accelerated by vibration and road debris.
fix: Repair or replace rusted panels, apply anti-corrosion treatment.
warning_signs: ["Visible rust bubbles on front wings", "Paint flaking near wheel arches"]
inspection_advice: Check front wings and inner wheel arches thoroughly for rust, especially on diesel models.
notes: Merged from 'Rust on front wings' and 'Rusty front wheel arches'.

label: FSI engine carbon buildup on intake valves
symptom: Engine runs lean off idle and is down on power.
cause: Direct injection design leads to carbon deposits on intake valves.
fix: Walnut blasting or chemical cleaning of intake valves.
inspection_advice: Check for rough idle and consider a borescope inspection of intake valves.
notes: Common to all direct injection FSI engines. Merged with general carbon/oil consumption for 1.4.

label: Timing chain tensioner failure and oil dependency
symptom: Timing chain stretches and can jump, potentially causing catastrophic engine failure. Low oil level prevents the timing chain tensioner from working correctly, leading to chain slack.
cause: Tensioner design failure and low oil level.
fix: Replace timing chain and tensioner with updated parts, maintain proper oil level.
inspection_advice: Listen for timing chain rattle at startup; check service history for tensioner replacement.
notes: Merged from 'timing_chain_tensioner_failure' and 'oil_dependency_tensioner_operation' as related causes.

label: Turbo vane clogging from carbon
symptom: Turbo cuts out at speed due to carbon and sediment clogging the variable vane mechanism.
cause: Carbon and sediment buildup in turbo variable vanes.
warning_signs: ["Loss of power at high speed", "Turbo lag"]
inspection_advice: Check for turbo performance and any fault codes.
